title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning and harden audit logging for residency policies
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning in RBAC v2 policy evaluation and harden audit logging for data residency enforcement. Motivation: customers in regulated industries require strict KMS region residency guarantees and traceable audit trails when RBAC policies require region-bound keys. This change ties KMS key residency checks into policy evaluation, surfaces failures to the caller with clear error codes, and enhances audit events to include KMS key fingerprint, region, and policy decision context. Checklist: - [x] Policy engine: add kms_region constraint evaluation and canonicalize match semantics - [x] Enforcement path: return clear RESIDENCY_VIOLATION error and metric - [x] Audit logs: include kms_key_fingerprint, kms_region, policy_id, decision, and request_trace_id - [x] Docs: update RBAC v2 policy schema and migration notes - [x] Terraform/installer: add opt-in toggle for strict residency enforcement for private deployments - [x] Tests: unit + integration + e2e for region mismatch and positive flows. Changes: - Policy schema extended with optional "kms_region" constraint on resource principals and secrets. Example: "kms_region": "eu-west-1". - Policy evaluator now performs a KMS metadata lookup (cache-backed) to determine key_region and compares against constraint; lookup is performed with a soft-fail mode when enforcement is disabled. - New error class RESIDENCY_VIOLATION surfaced to API with 403 status and machine-readable code. - Audit pipeline: enriched audit protobuf with kms_key_fingerprint, kms_region, resolved_principal, policy_id, and decision_reason. - Ops: metrics (rbac.residency_violation.count, rbac.kms_lookup.latency) and alerts for spikes. Backwards compatibility: default behavior is audit-only for existing customers; strict enforcement must be enabled via org config or installer flag. Migration notes: operators should review org-level residency settings before enabling enforcement. Related: ENG-4921, SEC-812. Testing: included unit tests for evaluator, integration tests using a fake KMS metadata service, and an e2e test in the perf-canary infra to validate audit event fields.

review_comments: Elliot Chen: Nice work. Can we avoid an extra RPC on the hot path by relying on the existing KMS metadata cache in runtime? If not, add a histogram metric for the lookup latency.
Aisha Kapoor: Reworked evaluator to use the runtime cache and added rbac.kms_lookup.latency histogram. The cache TTL defaults to 5m and is configurable per-deployment.
Marta Ruiz: Audit payload looks good. Suggest including the resolved_principal.email when present and truncating long fingerprints in logs to first 16 chars to avoid log bloat.
Aisha Kapoor: Added resolved_principal.email to payload and truncated fingerprint in human-readable logs while audit protobuf keeps full fingerprint.
ci_summary: E2E perf-canary: validated audit field presence ✔
release_notes: Enforced optional KMS region pinning for RBAC v2 policies and hardened audit logging. Operators can enable strict enforcement via org settings or installer flag. Audit logs now include kms_key_fingerprint, kms_region, policy_id, and decision_reason for compliance auditing.
notes_for_ops: Default rollout is audit-only. To enable strict enforcement set org_setting.rbac.residency_enforcement=true or pass --enforce-residency=true to the private installer. Verify KMS metadata service availability and warm caches before flipping to avoid elevated latency/denials.
migration_instructions: 1) Review org residency settings in Console. 2) Run migration script to annotate existing secrets with kms_region if available. 3) Enable enforcement in a canary org for 24h and monitor rbac.residency_violation.count and rbac.kms_lookup.latency. 4) Gradually roll out.
testing_notes: Fake KMS metadata service used for CI integration. Added tests for matching, mismatch, missing-key, and cache-expiry cases. E2E verified via perf-canary sending sample requests with mismatched regions and asserting audit event fields.
security_review: SEC-812 completed: threat model updated to include malicious metadata responses; added signature verification for KMS metadata in private deployments using org KMS trust anchors.
